messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

message.content: At 10 kPa the equilibrium between ice and liquid water occurs at roughly **–2 °C** (about –3 °C depending on the source). This is an approximate value derived from the water phase diagram; the exact freezing point varies slightly with impurities and measurement precision.
